title: Hand Back To Discussion Input
description: One hand-back from a sibling agent (spawned, or working beside the discussion) to the discussion agent: the agent that is talking with the person right now. It carries a card, a question, context, a result or a blocker, complete enough that the discussion agent can put it in front of the person without opening the sibling's thread. A question or decision carries the ask-the-person input unchanged, so the card the person sees is composed once, by the agent that did the analysis.

title.description: The sibling's thread or task title, as the person would recognise it.

link.description: A link to the sibling's thread, session or PR, so the person can open it for more. Never the only place the content is.

process.description: The process and step the sibling is in (process-state), or "none".

kind.description: decision and question need the person's answer and carry `ask`. context, result and blocker inform; a blocker that needs the person to act is a decision, not a blocker.

summary.description: One sentence that stands alone: what the person needs to know or choose.

ask.description: The composed question, exactly as ask-the-person takes it. Required for decision and question.

context.description: For context, result and blocker: what happened, what it touches and what happens next, every id glossed.

links.description: PRs, issues, staging pages and files the hand-back is about, each with a title.

channels.description: Every place the hand-back is shown. The discussion is always one of them; a review sheet or an issue is an extra copy, never the only one.

answerRoute.description: How the answer reaches the sibling again. An answer typed at the discussion does not reach the sibling by itself.

how.description: thread-message: the host's message-to-thread tool, with the person's message attached by id. send-message: a sibling session's inbox. return-value: the sibling is a subagent and the answer goes into its next prompt. issue-comment and sheet: the sibling reads it there.

target.description: The thread id, session id, issue or sheet row the answer goes to.

blocking.description: true when the sibling has stopped and waits on the answer; false when it keeps working on the recommended option.

supersedes.description: The id of an earlier hand-back this one replaces; the discussion agent withdraws that card.

discussion.title: Discussion link
discussion.description: Who is talking with the person, and how to reach them. A spawning agent puts this in every brief it writes during a live discussion (process-state §"A coordinator that briefs a thread").

agent.description: The discussion agent, for example "project coordinator" or the parent session's id.

how.description: coordinator-message: the host's message-to-coordinator tool (Claude projects). thread-message: message another thread. send-message: a sibling session's inbox. return-value: the sibling is a subagent; the hand-back is its final report.

rules.description: Standing rules the discussion applies to cards, such as "relay every card to project chat with lettered options".

row.description: review-sheet: the row's key (a change set id or a comment number), never a row index.

column.description: review-sheet: the column, by header, e.g. "Change Set Feedback (agent)" or "Feedback (agent)".
